allyofjusticegaradholg.name: Ally of Justice Garadholg
allyofjusticegaradholg.desc: If this card battles a LIGHT monster, it gains 200 ATK during the Damage Step only.

crowtengu.name: Crow Tengu
crowtengu.desc: If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect and sent to your GY, or if this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can target 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Crow Tengu" once per turn.

deepseasentry.name: Deep Sea Sentry
deepseasentry.desc: If this card is sent to the GY to activate a WATER monster's effect: You can make your opponent banish 1 card from their hand face-up, until the End Phase. If this card is Special Summoned: You can send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower WATER monster in your GY, except "Deep Sea Sentry"; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Deep Sea Sentry" once per turn.

deslacooda.name: Des Lacooda
deslacooda.desc: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Draw 1 card.

dragonecronethersouldragon.name: Dragonecro Nethersoul Dragon
dragonecronethersouldragon.desc:
2 Zombie monsters
Must first be Fusion Summoned. Monsters cannot be destroyed by battle with this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled a monster that has an original Level: That monster's ATK becomes 0, also, if that monster is still face-up on the field, Special Summon 1 "Dark Soul Token" (Zombie/DARK/Level ?/ATK ?/DEF 0). (When Summoned, its Level and ATK become equal to the original Level and ATK of that monster.) You can only control 1 "Dragonecro Nethersoul Dragon".

dragonshrine.name: Dragon Shrine
dragonshrine.desc: Send 1 Dragon monster from your Deck to the GY, then, if that monster in your GY is a Dragon Normal Monster, you can send 1 more Dragon monster from your Deck to the GY. You can only activate 1 "Dragon Shrine" per turn.

evilswarmzahak.name: Evilswarm Zahak
evilswarmzahak.desc: If this face-up card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card (by battle or card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: Target 1 Special Summoned Level 5 or higher monster on the field; destroy that target.

exosistermartha.name: Exosister Martha
exosistermartha.desc: If you control no monsters, or only Xyz Monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Exosister Elis" from your Deck. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate this effect, except "Exosister" monsters. If a card(s) moves out of either GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Exosister" Xyz Monster, using this face-up card you control as material. (This is treated as an Xyz Summon.) You can only use each effect of "Exosister Martha" once per turn.

finalcountdown.name: Final Countdown
finalcountdown.desc: Pay 2000 Life Points. After 20 turns have passed (counting the turn you activate this card as the 1st turn), you win the Duel.

heraldicbeastaberconway.name: Heraldic Beast Aberconway
heraldicbeastaberconway.desc: If this card is in the Graveyard: You can banish another "Heraldic Beast Aberconway" from your Graveyard to target 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Heraldic Beast Aberconway" once per turn.

heroicchallengerthousandblades.name: Heroic Challenger - Thousand Blades
heroicchallengerthousandblades.desc: Once per turn, if this card is in Attack Position: You can discard 1 "Heroic" card; you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except "Heroic" monsters, also Special Summon 1 "Heroic" monster from your Deck, and if you do, change this card to Defense Position. When you take damage while this card is in your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card in Attack Position. You can only use this effect of "Heroic Challenger - Thousand Blades" once per turn.

igknightburst.name: Igknight Burst
igknightburst.desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can destroy up to 3 other "Igknight" cards you control, then return an equal number of cards your opponent controls to the hand. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 face-up "Igknight" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand.

infernoidsjette.name: Infernoid Sjette
infernoidsjette.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or Graveyard) by banishing 2 "Infernoid" monsters from your hand or Graveyard while the total Levels and Ranks of all Effect Monsters you control are 8 or lower, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card declares an attack: You can banish 1 monster from your opponent's Extra Deck (their choice). Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard; banish it.

junksynchron.name: Junk Synchron
junksynchron.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 2 or lower monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position, but it has its effects negated.

k966blantern.name: K9-66b Lantern
k966blantern.desc: If your opponent has 2 or more cards in their hand, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "K9-66b Lantern" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Level 5 non-Pyro "K9" monster in your GY; Special Summon both it and this card, but they cannot be used as material for the Xyz Summon of a LIGHT monster. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "K9" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.

lancephorhynchus.name: Lancephorhynchus
lancephorhynchus.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
If a Normal Monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

[ Monster Effect ] 
''This primordial species survived extinction by evolving an offensive lance that can pierce anything, although its diet still consists mainly of fish.''

livingfossil.name: Living Fossil
livingfossil.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 Level 4 or lower monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card, but banish it when it leaves the field (even if this card has left the field). When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster. The equipped monster loses 1000 ATK/DEF, also its effects are negated. You can only activate 1 "Living Fossil" per turn.

madolchepuddingcesschocolatalamode.name: Madolche Puddingcess Chocolat-a-la-Mode
madolchepuddingcesschocolatalamode.desc:
2 Level 5 EARTH monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a Rank 4 or lower "Madolche" Xyz Monster you control as the material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Once per turn: You can target 1 "Madolche" card in your GY; shuffle it into the Deck. While this card has "Madolche Puddingcess" as material, when a "Madolche" card(s) in your GY is shuffled into the Main Deck (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Madolche" monster from your Deck in Attack Position or face-down Defense Position.

mechaphantombeastaerosguin.name: Mecha Phantom Beast Aerosguin
mechaphantombeastaerosguin.desc: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast" monster from your Graveyard, except "Mecha Phantom Beast Aerosguin"; Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine-Type/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0). This card's Level is increased by the total Levels of all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control. While you control a Token, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

mentalseeker.name: Mental Seeker
mentalseeker.desc: When this removed from play card is Special Summoned, reveal the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck. Choose 1 of those cards and remove it from play. Then, shuffle the others into the Deck.

meteonisdrytron.name: Meteonis Drytron
meteonisdrytron.desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any Ritual Monster from your hand or GY. You must also Tribute Machine monsters from your hand or field whose total ATK equal or exceed the ATK of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Drytron" monster you control; it loses exactly 1000 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn, and if it does, add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Meteonis Drytron" once per turn.

nightlizard.name: Night Lizard
nightlizard.desc: ''A lizard warrior protected by a hide of very tough emerald scales.''

number4stealthkragen.name: Number 4: Stealth Kragen
number4stealthkragen.desc:
2 Level 4 WATER monsters
All face-up monsters on the field become WATER. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 WATER monster your opponent controls, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK it had on the field. If this Xyz Summoned card is destroyed: You can Special Summon "Stealth Kragen Spawn(s)" from your Extra Deck, up to the number of materials this card had, then you can attach up to 1 WATER monster from your GY to each of those Special Summoned monsters as material.

powerinvader.name: Power Invader
powerinvader.desc: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing.

qadshaddollkeios.name: Qadshaddoll Keios
qadshaddollkeios.desc:
FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 "Shaddoll" monster from your hand in face-up or face-down Defense Position.
If this card is sent to the GY by a card effect: You can send 1 "Shaddoll" monster from your hand to the GY, and if you do, for the rest of this turn, all monsters you control gain ATK/DEF equal to the original Level of that monster sent to the GY x 100. You can only use 1 "Qadshaddoll Keios" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

regulus.name: Regulus
regulus.desc: Once per turn, you can select 1 Field Spell Card in your Graveyard. Return it to the Deck.

samuraioftheicebarrier.name: Samurai of the Ice Barrier
samuraioftheicebarrier.desc: When this face-up Attack Position card is changed to face-up Defense Position: Destroy this card, and if you do, draw 1 card.

santaclaws.name: Santa Claws
santaclaws.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) to your opponent's field in Defense Position, by Tributing 1 monster they control. If Summoned this way, once, during the End Phase of this turn: You can draw 1 card.

scareclawlightheart.name: Scareclaw Light-Heart
scareclawlightheart.desc:
1 "Scareclaw" monster or 1 "Visas Starfrost"
For this card's Link Summon, you can only use monsters in your Main Monster Zone as material. If this card is Link Summoned in the Extra Monster Zone: You can add 1 "Primitive Planet Reichphobia" from your Deck to your hand. If you control "Visas Starfrost": You can Special Summon this card from your GY. You can only use this effect of "Scareclaw Light-Heart" once per Duel.

spellproofarmor.name: Spell Proof Armor
spellproofarmor.desc:
[Activate this Skill during your Main Phase.] 

All Machine monsters you control are unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects. You can Normal Summon Machine Normal Monsters with 1 less Tribute. If a non-Machine monster is in your GY, flip this Skill over. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

superheavysamuraithief.name: Superheavy Samurai Thief

triamidloading.name: Triamid Loading
triamidloading.desc: If a Field Spell is placed face-up in the Field Zone: You can add 1 "Triamid" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Triamid Loading". If a face-up Rock monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Triamid" monster with a different name from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Triamid Loading" once per turn.

trickstarlightstage.name: Trickstar Light Stage
trickstarlightstage.desc: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Trickstar" monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone; while this card is in the Field Zone, that Set card cannot be activated until the End Phase, and your opponent must activate it during the End Phase or else send it to the GY. Each time a "Trickstar" monster you control inflicts battle or effect damage to your opponent, inflict 200 damage to them.

tylerthegreatwarrior.name: Tyler the Great Warrior
tylerthegreatwarrior.desc: This monster cannot be Special Summoned. When this card destroys a monster as a result of battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster.

vishwarrandi.name: Vishwar Randi
vishwarrandi.desc: ''This lady warrior with unquenchable bloodlust serves the forces of darkness.''

zefraprovidence.name: Zefra Providence
zefraprovidence.desc: Add 1 "Zefra" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Zefra Providence". If a "Zefra" card(s) you control would be destroyed, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard, you can banish this card from your Graveyard instead. You can only activate 1 "Zefra Providence" per turn.
